highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.152.0 adds Skia m152, Graphite GPU bindings, asynchronous readback, and broad native reliability fixes.
highlights_body: It expands Vulkan support, improves Apple and Android symbol packages, fixes native object lifetime bugs, and reduces allocations in core and HarfBuzzSharp APIs.

bullets.detail: Moves the bundled renderer to Chrome milestone 152, including the m152 servicing and GlyphData stability updates.

bullets.lead: Graphite GPU and asynchronous readback APIs
bullets.detail: Adds Graphite bindings for Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn, plus backend-neutral asynchronous RequestReadPixels APIs on SKImage and SKSurface.
Fixes use-after-free risks in SKRegion iterators and SKPixmap subsets, an SKImage raster failure buffer leak, and an undisposed stream asset conversion.

bullets.lead: Runtime effect, data, and shaping paths allocate less
bullets.detail: Improves uniform lookup construction and reset behavior, avoids redundant data copies, and removes defensive HarfBuzz feature-array copies and tag boxing.

bullets.lead: Native package and Vulkan support expanded
bullets.detail: Restores the Vulkan Silk.NET package, adds platform symbol-package support, and uses FreeType for Nano Server font handling.

contributor_summaries.mmitche: MSVC environment initialization for native builds

preview_summaries.v4.152.0-preview.1.1: Preview 1 introduced m152, Graphite bindings, asynchronous pixel readback, and native lifetime fixes.
preview_summaries.v4.152.0-rc.1.26426.14: The release candidate completed platform packaging, Vulkan, and shaping performance improvements.

harfbuzz_summary: HarfBuzzSharp reduces shaping allocations and is synchronized with the m152 platform release.
